# TinyC examples

Every program in [`examples/`](../examples/) with its title and a short explanation (237 programs, 19 include libraries).

*Generated by `tasmota/tinyc/scripts/gen_examples_doc.mjs` from the comments at the top of each example — do not edit this file.*
*To improve an explanation, change the comment in the `.tc`, or put a line `name | text` into `scripts/examples_descriptions.txt`.*

How to run one: the IDE's "Load Example…" list, the repo page `/tcrepo` on the device (compiles and starts the example straight from this repository), or
`node tasmota/tinyc/tc_deploy.mjs examples/<name>.tc <device-ip>`. The `#include` libraries at the end have no `main()` and are pulled in by the programs that use them.

## Include libraries

Building blocks in `examples/common/`: no `main()`, used with `#include "name.tc"`.

| File | Title | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`ak09918.tc`](../examples/common/ak09918.tc) | ak09918 | AK09918C 3-axis magnetometer / compass (I2C 0x0C, fixed address), pure TinyC. |
| [`cfg.tc`](../examples/common/cfg.tc) | cfg | read and validate key=value configuration files (.cfg / .secret), pure TinyC, no firmware change. |
| [`ct002_common.tc`](../examples/common/ct002_common.tc) | ct002_common | Marstek CT002 / CT003 emulator on UDP 12345, as a building block. Defines no callbacks; the including program owns them and calls ctInit/ctPoll/ctTick/ctTask/ctRows/ctPanel/ctWebOn/ctCmd/ctJson. |
| [`eco_shelly_common.tc`](../examples/common/eco_shelly_common.tc) | eco_shelly_common | EcoTracker / Shelly Pro 3EM emulator as a building block. Defines no callbacks; the including program owns them and calls the functions below. Meter setup comes from sml_descriptor.tc, telemetry from the base program. |
| [`ecotracker_emu.tc`](../examples/common/ecotracker_emu.tc) | ecotracker_emu | minimaler EcoTracker-Emulator zum EINBINDEN |
| [`ha_discovery.tc`](../examples/common/ha_discovery.tc) | ha_discovery | Home Assistant MQTT discovery for the emulators' settings that may change at runtime (offset, Max DC), as number entities. |
| [`ina219.tc`](../examples/common/ina219.tc) | ina219 | INA219 voltage / current / power monitor (I2C), pure TinyC. |
| [`ld19.tc`](../examples/common/ld19.tc) | ld19 | LDROBOT LD19 / STL-19P / D500 360 degree 2D lidar (UART, 230400 baud), pure TinyC. |
| [`modbus_lib.tc`](../examples/common/modbus_lib.tc) | modbus_lib | Modbus TCP helpers for TinyC (v1.6.0+) |
| [`nas_backup.tc`](../examples/common/nas_backup.tc) | nas_backup | copy local files to a NAS over FTP (FRITZ!NAS, Synology, any FTP server) and free the space. |
| [`net_watchdog.tc`](../examples/common/net_watchdog.tc) | net_watchdog | restart a device whose network stack hangs, and keep a small "black box" file. |
| [`pv_switch_common.tc`](../examples/common/pv_switch_common.tc) | pv_switch_common | switches another Tasmota device (a smart plug for a pool pump, say) on PV surplus, like the Scripter's option (Op1). Defines no callbacks; the including program calls swTick / swRows / swPanel. |
| [`qmi8658.tc`](../examples/common/qmi8658.tc) | qmi8658 | QMI8658C 6-axis IMU (3-axis accelerometer + 3-axis gyroscope + temperature, I2C), pure TinyC. |
| [`sml_chart_common.tc`](../examples/common/sml_chart_common.tc) | sml_chart_common | chart engine for the SML family: rolling 4 h / 24 h power charts plus daily, monthly and yearly totals, both directions. |
| [`sml_descriptor.tc`](../examples/common/sml_descriptor.tc) | sml_descriptor | the meter setup every program of the family shares: descriptor, pins, filter, driver rows, restart. Defines no callbacks. |
| [`sml_modbus_common.tc`](../examples/common/sml_modbus_common.tc) | sml_modbus_common | Modbus-TCP slave as a building block. Defines no callbacks; the including program owns them and calls the functions below. |
| [`ui_common.tc`](../examples/common/ui_common.tc) | ui_common | language switch and help links for the whole family. |
| [`vl53l0x_mux.tc`](../examples/common/vl53l0x_mux.tc) | vl53l0x_mux | VL53L0X time-of-flight sensors, up to 4 on the channels of a TCA9548A I2C multiplexer (include library, no main()). |
| [`wheel_enc.tc`](../examples/common/wheel_enc.tc) | wheel_enc | two wheel encoders (one per drive side) -> ticks, distance, speed, odometry and a stall detector. Pure TinyC on top of Tasmota's own pulse counters (interrupt driven), so it counts at kHz rates without loading the VM. |
